arguments.command:
cat > /app/tmp/t/test_ack.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/tmp/t")
from harness import *

ok = True
def A0(frames, t=1, level="A"):
    return [key(0,"A","install"), dg(t,1200,[pkt(level,0,True,frames)])]
def I0(frames, t=0):
    return [dg(t,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,frames)])]

# ---- ACK frame encoding errors
for name, ranges in [
    ("ack empty", []),
    ("ack reversed", [[5,3]]),
    ("ack adjacent", [[0,1],[2,3]]),
    ("ack overlapping", [[0,5],[3,9]]),
    ("ack unsorted", [[10,20],[0,5]]),
    ("ack dup", [[0,5],[0,5]]),
    ("ack nested", [[0,10],[2,3]]),
]:
    ok &= check(name, CFG(), A0([ACK(*ranges)]),
        RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,0)],
            conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [],
            [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# ---- coverage: PROTOCOL_VIOLATION when acking unsent numbers
SENT = {"I":[[0,4],[10,14],[20,20]],"H":[],"A":[[100,200],[300,400]]}
cases = [
    ("ack covered single", [[0,4]], None),
    ("ack covered two", [[10,14],[20,20]], None),
    ("ack covered gap", [[0,4],[10,14]], None),
    ("ack below", [[0,3]], "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"),
    ("ack above", [[1,4]], "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"),
    ("ack partial top", [[0,5]], "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"),
    ("ack spanning hole", [[0,20]], "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"),
    ("ack in hole", [[5,9]], "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"),
    ("ack straddling", [[3,11]], "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"),
    ("ack beyond", [[21,30]], "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"),
    ("ack far", [[4611686018427387903,4611686018427387903]], "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"),
    ("ack second range bad", [[0,4],[15,16]], "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"),
    ("ack first range bad", [[6,9],[10,14]], "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"),
    ("ack huge range covered", [[100,400]], None),
    ("ack huge range partial", [[100,401]], "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"),
    ("ack 150-250", [[150,250]], "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"),
    ("ack 201-299", [[201,299]], "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION"),
]
for name, ranges, err in cases:
    if err is None:
        ok &= check(name, CFG(sent=SENT), A0([ACK(*ranges)]),
            RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [],
                [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
    else:
        ok &= check(name, CFG(sent=SENT), A0([ACK(*ranges)]),
            RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error",err,1,0)],
                conn_closed(err,1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [],
                [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# per number space
ok &= check("ack I space", CFG(sent={"I":[[0,4]],"H":[[0,4]],"A":[]}), I0([ACK([0,4])]),
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("ack I wrong space", CFG(sent={"I":[],"H":[[0,4]],"A":[]}), I0([ACK([0,4])]),
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,0)],
        conn_closed("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,src(0,0,0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("ack H space", CFG(sent={"I":[],"H":[[0,4]],"A":[]}), [key(0,"H","install"),dg(1,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[ACK([0,4])])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(h="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("ack A vs H", CFG(sent={"I":[],"H":[[0,4]],"A":[]}), A0([ACK([0,4])]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",1,0)],
        conn_closed("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# symbolic large ranges (no enumeration)
BIG = 4611686018427387903
ok &= check("ack symbolic huge", CFG(sent={"I":[[0,BIG]],"H":[],"A":[]}), I0([ACK([0,BIG])]),
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("ack symbolic huge miss", CFG(sent={"I":[[0,BIG-1]],"H":[],"A":[]}), I0([ACK([0,BIG])]),
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,0)],
        conn_closed("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,src(0,0,0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("ack symbolic many ranges", CFG(sent={"I":[[2*i,2*i] for i in range(32)],"H":[],"A":[]}),
        I0([ACK(*[[2*i,2*i] for i in range(32)])]),
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# ACK has no other effects; multiple ACKs in one packet
ok &= check("two acks", CFG(sent={"I":[[0,4]],"H":[],"A":[]}), I0([ACK([0,4]),ACK([2,4])]),
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# ACK error rolls back earlier frame effects in the same packet
ok &= check("ack rollback", CFG(sent={"I":[],"H":[],"A":[]}), I0([CRY(0,"aabb"),ACK([0,0])]),
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,1)],
        conn_closed("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,src(0,0,1)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

print("ALL PASS" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/t && python3 test_ack.py 2>&1 | grep -E "^FAIL|ALL PASS|SOME FAILED" -A2
